$comment: The places this site publishes. Editing this file is the whole editorial surface: the next run adds what appeared here and prunes what left. A group is drawn as one places_comparison and holds at most four places, which is both the chart's own limit and the point where four lines stop being readable.

site.title: Lomsdal-Visten Almanac
site.tagline: Point forecasts from three models, redrawn through the day.

places.name: Trondheim
places.note: City on the Trondheimsfjord, on the way in

places.name: Mosjøen
places.note: Town at the head of the Vefsnfjord, nearest the northern start

places.name: Mo i Rana
places.note: Town on the Ranfjord, between Trondheim and Bodø; 13.1 m per Kartverket dtm1

places.name: Bodø
places.note: Town at the northern end of the way in, and the crossing to Lofoten; 8.9 m per Kartverket dtm1

places.name: Tverrådalen
places.note: Valley floor at the northern start; forest, per Kartverket dtm1

places.name: Fjellskardet
places.note: Pass west of Tverrådalen; open ground, 504.7 m per Kartverket dtm1

places.name: Burrienvaerie
places.note: Mountain name-point used as a high-terrain proxy

places.name: Bønå hurtigbåtkai
places.note: Fast-boat quay

places.name: Austerfjorden
places.note: Fjord head at sea level; open ground, 1.3 m per Kartverket dtm1

places.name: Stigfjellet
places.note: High mountain point east of Bønå; open ground, 678.6 m per Kartverket dtm1

places.name: Grunnvatnet
places.note: Lake point between Stigfjellet and Vistfjellan; open ground, 609.9 m per Kartverket dtm1

places.name: Vistfjellan
places.note: The high point of the central line; open ground, 903.0 m per Kartverket dtm1. Not Visttindan, which is 11 km south

places.name: Eiteråfjellet
places.note: Open ground at 323.5 m per Kartverket dtm1; a given coordinate, no longer a name-point proxy

places.name: Visttindan
places.note: High-elevation stress-test proxy; not assumed to lie on the track

places.name: Lomsdalen
places.note: Interior valley point

places.name: Nedre Breivatnet
places.note: Optional lower-lake point for the descent and river section

places.name: Midtre Breivatnet
places.note: Higher Breivatnet lake point

places.name: Stavassgården
places.note: Tourist cabin in Stavvassdalen, so registered by Kartverket; 269.2 m, open ground

places.name: Elgviddevatnet
places.note: 625.7 m on open ground. Kartverket has no name here; the nearest is the plateau Sarvejællan Åarjelguevtele, 'sarve' being South Sámi for elk

places.name: Reine
places.note: The village on Moskenesøya; 12.2 m per Kartverket dtm1

places.name: Markan
places.note: Mountain in Lofotodden nasjonalpark, 8 km north of Reine; 396.3 m, open ground

places.name: Björkliden station
places.note: Malmbanan halt above Torneträsk; the northern way in. 425 m per Open-Meteo's 90 m DEM, 434 m per Mapzen

places.name: Abisko Östra station
places.note: The village halt, one stop before Abisko Turiststation. 390 m per DEM against OpenStreetMap's surveyed 388 m

places.name: STF Kårsavagge fjällstuga
places.note: Cabin in the Kårsavagge valley, the highest of the four. 700 m per DEM, 713 m per Mapzen; no surveyed figure

places.name: STF Abiskojaure fjällstuga
places.note: Cabin at Ábeskojávri on the Kungsleden, south of the others. 490 m per DEM and per OpenStreetMap alike

places.name: Tosbotnet
places.note: Low-elevation southern endpoint

groups.name: Entrance
groups.note: The towns on the way in, south to north. Far apart and far from the route, so this map is drawn at a much smaller scale than the others. Four is the most a comparison draws, so this section is now full.

groups.name: Northern section
groups.note: Northern start, the pass west of it, mountain proxy and quay, in the stated route sequence.

groups.name: Central section 1
groups.note: Fjord head, the mountain above it and the lake beyond, west to east.

groups.name: Central section 2
groups.note: The high point of the line and the descent east of it. Split from section 1 here because the 4.7 km between Grunnvatnet and Vistfjellan is the widest gap in the row, and a comparison draws at most four places.

groups.name: Central section 3
groups.note: Visttindan and the Lomsdalen valley point, south of the others.

groups.name: Southern section
groups.note: Lower and higher Breivatnet points followed by the southern endpoint.

groups.name: Eastern section
groups.note: Stavassgården and the plateau south-west of it, east of the Breivatnet points and at much the same latitude.

groups.name: Lofoten
groups.note: Not the route: Reine on Moskenesøya and the mountain above it, 250 km north. Last, so the route reads through from Entrance to Eastern without a detour.

groups.name: Abisko
groups.note: Not the route: a few days in Swedish Lapland, 400 km north-east. Two Malmbanan halts and two STF cabins. No locator map: Kartverket draws nothing over Sweden, so the render leaves it out.
